title.en: An Act Providing for the Establishment of an Emergency Hospital in the Municipality of Placer, Province of Surigao del Norte, to be Known as Placer Emergency Hospital, and Authorizing the Appropriation of Funds Therefor

text.en: There shall be established under the direct supervision of the Director of Medical Services, an emergency hospital in the Municipality of Placer, Province of Surigao del Norte, to be known as Placer Emergency Hospital.

The sum of one hundred thousand pesos is hereby authorized to be appropriated, out of any funds in the National Treasury not otherwise appropriated, for the establishment, operation and maintenance of said hospital during the fiscal year nineteen hundred sixty-nine. Thereafter, such sum as may be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 15, 1968.
